messages:
maria.g: quick follow-up from today's postmortem — I'm consolidating remediation owners and mapping recurring failure patterns into a sprintboard card. can folks ack owners for the DR / regional failover items below?

aj: ack. I can own multi-region routing tests and the game day coordination.

leah: I’ll take backups + snapshot verification. ETA end of day Tue 2025-06-03 for the first checklist.

samir: I can own the restore-runbook updates. need to confirm we have partial-artifact restore steps and a clear rollback path. added a TODO on the runbook.

nate: tagging recurring pattern: "KV-store timeouts during cross-region failover" — saw this 3x in Q1/Q2. suggest we add a cache rehydrate step + circuit breaker.

ops-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/342 by samir — status: review_required (reminder set for 48h).

maria.g: @aj @leah @samir please add owners to the sprintboard and put rough estimates (hours). target game day: 2025-06-10. add test tags: smoke, full-restore, routing-validation.

leah: added checklist snippet to the sprintboard card:
```
- verify snapshot integrity
- restore to staging
- smoke test API endpoints
- validate token routing and permissions
```
I’ll include expected time per step.

aj: scheduling game day 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC, invite sent. I'll add routing playbook steps + traffic-shift helper script snippet:
```
# gradual shift example
./route-shift --from eu-west1 --to us-west1 --percent 20
```
I'll also prepare a fallback to immediate rollback.

samir: FYI logs from last failover show latency bump ~30s before the switch. I'll add a metric-based pre-failover alert: p95 latency > 2s for 10m. also will update runbook with artifact verification commands.

maria.g: perfect. owners summary: aj (routing & game day), leah (backups & snapshots), samir (runbook + alerts), nate (pattern analysis). I'll create a follow-up thread after the game day for closure statuses. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
